# Gramercy Drugs & Surgical

> > A comprehensive medical supply store in Brooklyn, NY offering pharmacy services, surgical supplies, mobility aids, and specialty healthcare products with free delivery across NYC.

Gramercy Drugs & Surgical is a full-service medical supply and pharmacy retailer based in Brooklyn serving the NYC metro area including Manhattan, Queens, and surrounding regions. The store specializes in prescription services, home healthcare equipment, mobility solutions, and specialty pharmacy management for chronic conditions.

## Pharmacy Services

- [Pharmacy](https://www.gramercydrugs.net/pharmacy): Pharmacy services in NYC including prescription refills, specialty, and compounding.
- [Specialty Pharmacy](https://www.gramercydrugs.net/specialty-pharmacy): Specialty pharmacy for HIV/AIDS, Multiple Sclerosis, Hemophilia, chronic disease management.
- [Compounding](https://www.gramercydrugs.net/compounding): Pharmacy compounding services for customized medications in NYC.
- [Refill Rx Online](https://www.gramercydrugs.net/refill-rx-online): Online prescription refill service with Transfer Rx and Auto Rx Refill options.
- [Transfer RX](https://www.gramercydrugs.net/transfer-rx): Transfer RX prescription transfer service for Brooklyn pharmacy customers.
- [Auto Rx Refill](https://www.gramercydrugs.net/auto-rx-refill): Automatic prescription refill service for regular medication management in Brooklyn.

## Surgical & Medical Supplies

- [Surgical Supplies](https://www.gramercydrugs.net/surgical-supplies): Surgical supplies for NY, NJ, CT including post-surgery recovery and ostomy products.
- [Orthotics & Prosthetics](https://www.gramercydrugs.net/orthotics-prosthetics): Orthotics and prosthetics including arch supports, shoes, bracing for foot/heel/leg pain.
- [Sleep Therapy](https://www.gramercydrugs.net/surgical-supplies/sleep-therapy): Sleep therapy products and services in Brooklyn, NY with pharmacist consultation.

## Mobility & Accessibility Equipment

- [Wheelchairs](https://www.gramercydrugs.net/product-category/surgical-supplies/wheelchairs): Wheelchair product catalog including bariatric, transport, and adaptive equipment.
- [Power Mobility](https://www.gramercydrugs.net/product-category/surgical-supplies/power-mobility): Power mobility products including Bobcat scooters and Cirrus power wheelchairs.
- [Rollators & Walkers](https://www.gramercydrugs.net/product-category/surgical-supplies/rollators): Rollators and walkers for mobility and accessibility needs.
- [Bath Safety](https://www.gramercydrugs.net/product-category/surgical-supplies/bath-safety): Bath safety equipment including AquaJoy bathlifts and accessibility products.

## Home Healthcare Products

- [Medical Beds](https://www.gramercydrugs.net/product-category/surgical-supplies/beds): Medical beds including bariatric, hospital, and patient care bed equipment.
- [Orthopedic Supplies](https://www.gramercydrugs.net/product-category/surgical-supplies/orthopedics): Orthopedic supplies including ankle braces, stabilizers, and supportive equipment.
- [Incontinence Products](https://www.gramercydrugs.net/product-category/surgical-supplies/incontinence): Incontinence products including Attends, Depend, ComfortAire, Dignity Plus brands.
